subject: c-act
title: C.ACT.------DYM.F.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 273 (CMBA-29). C-ACT (composite activism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: C-CONT (composite continuance) and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From C-CONT: TR (transformation). From INDIV-TD: INFO-F (information focus) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From TR: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From ALT-F: GRAD (gradualism) and LANG (language), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From LANG: RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
